about: Abbreviations school records hold (the federal school files: 'Shamokin Area El Sch', 'Northwestern MS') and the words people write for them. Read by schoolNameWords (src/english/school-names.ts) where a school's name is shown. Each key is a whole word, matched in any case and never before a period; 'onlyBeforeSchoolOrLast' words are expanded only before School or at the end of a name ('El' also begins place names: 'El Paso'); 'onlyBeforeHigh' words only before High ('Lincoln Jr High' is a junior high; 'Martin Luther King Jr Elementary' keeps the Jr of the person's name). 'onlyAfterFirstWord' words are expanded anywhere but first ('DeKalb Co Eastern' is a county, 'Co-op' is not); 'lowerCaseInsideAName' words are small after the first word ('Academy of Columbus'); 'spacedAbbreviations' are written with a space ('H S'). 'Ft' and 'Mt' with no period are Fort and Mount; a Roman numeral after 'R-' ('R-Ii') is capitalized again by schoolNameWords.
